passages.heading: Admission > Transfer of Graduate Credit > Graduate Credit Taken Prior to Admission to ATU
passages.body: A maximum of 50% of the coursework required for a graduate degree (e.g, fifteen (15) semester hours of graduate credit in a 30-hour program and eighteen (18) semester hours of graduate credit in a 36-hour program) with a grade point average of "B" or better may be transferred from an accredited graduate school if deemed appropriate to the graduate program by the head of the student's major department and the Dean of Graduate College. A maximum of three (3) semester hours of graduate credit with a grade point average of "B" or better may be transferred from an accredited graduate school for a graduate certificate program if deemed appropriate to the graduate program by the head of the student's major department and the Dean of Graduate College. No more than 50% of graduate coursework can be earned through PLA and/or transfer hours. If a student is transferring in military credit, please see the policy Graduate Credit Earned through Advanced Military Training.

passages.heading: Admission > Transfer of Graduate Credit > Graduate Credit Earned through Advanced Military Training
passages.body: Based on the military services transcript, advanced military training may be considered for acceptance as graduate-level transfer credit(s) at the discretion of the program director using ACE guidelines. A maximum of 50% of the coursework for a graduate degree can be earned through advanced military training. A minimum of 50% of the coursework for a graduate degree must be earned in residency at Arkansas Tech University. Advanced military training credit(s) must be approved by the graduate program director and the Graduate College before being applied to the student's program of study. Credit hour acceptance among graduate programs may vary based on program accreditation standards, curriculum alignment, program requirements, relevance of training to academic programs, and institutional or program policies.

passages.heading: Admission > Admission to Graduate College > Transfer Graduate Students
passages.body: Transfer students seeking admission to ATU's Graduate College must submit official transcripts from all colleges/universities where they have been officially registered in graduate coursework. Transfer students must meet unconditional admission standards and be in good academic standing at their previous graduate institution(s). Please see the Transfer of Graduate Credit section regarding transferring credit into an Arkansas ATU graduate program.

passages.heading: Admission > Credit for Prior Learning
passages.body: Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) is the process by which an individual's experiential and extra-institutional learning is assessed and evaluated for purposes of granting college credit. Supporting documentation that demonstrates learning outcomes, competencies, and professional skills gained through prior learning must be submitted. Students may be awarded credit for prior learning not to exceed 50% of the coursework required for a graduate degree (e.g., 15 hours for a 30 or 33 credit hour program or 18 hours for a 36-credit hour program). No more than 50% of coursework can be earned through PLA and/or transfer hours. Students may be awarded up to 3 credit hours for prior learning for a graduate certificate. The Arkansas Higher Education Coordinating Board sets credit limits for experiential/prior learning assessment. Not all programs provide the CPL credit option. Every student requesting credit for prior learning must submit the required documentation or complete an examination (as required by the degree program) to demonstrate the graduate-level learning that has resulted from experiences outside a formal academic framework. Faculty from the program will evaluate the CPL request to determine if the student qualifies for CPL credit. CPL credit must be earned for a specific course and cannot be earned for generic credit toward a graduate degree or certificate.
